summary.text: Aaron Reed is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 7, serving since 2025. The legislature's profile lists Reed as vice chair of the Senate Veterans, Military Affairs, & Public Protection Committee and a member of the Education, Judiciary, and Agriculture committees.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Aaron Reed was born on July 20, 1977, and is the owner of Kodiak Koating and Ops Supply.
The profile lists a B.A. in sociology/criminology from MoSU and service in the U.S. Navy, noting 22-plus years as a Navy SEAL and retirement as a senior chief.
It also lists him among the Navy SEAL Foundation, the UDT SEAL Association, and the Navy SEAL Legacy Foundation, and notes that he is an Eagle Scout.
